a.xlink:title: --- stage: integration image: python:3.11 services: - name: postgres:15 alias: database - name: redis:7-alpine alias: redis - name: elasticsearch:8.11.0 alias: search command: - bin/elasticsearch - "-Expack.security.enabled=false" variables: POSTGRES_DB: app_db POSTGRES_USER: app_user POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app_pass DATABASE_URL: postgresql://app_user:app_pass@database:5432/app_db REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379 ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://search:9200 script: - pip install psycopg2-binary redis elasticsearch - echo "Testing all service connections..." - python -c "import psycopg2; conn = psycopg2.connect('$DATABASE_URL'); print('PostgreSQL OK')" - python -c "import redis; r = redis.from_url('$REDIS_URL'); r.ping(); print('Redis OK')" - sleep 10 - python -c "from elasticsearch import Elasticsearch; es = Elasticsearch(['$ELASTICSEARCH_URL']); print('Elasticsearch OK')" - echo "Running full integration tests..."

--- stage: test image: ruby:3.2 services: - name: postgres:15 alias: db variables: POSTGRES_DB: test_database POSTGRES_USER: test_user POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test_password DATABASE_URL: postgresql://test_user:test_password@db:5432/test_database script: - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y postgresql-client - echo "Testing PostgreSQL connection..." - PGPASSWORD=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD psql -h db -U test_user -d test_database -c "SELECT version();" - echo "Running database migrations..." - echo "Running tests against database..."

--- stage: test image: node:18 services: - name: redis:7-alpine alias: cache variables: REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379 script: - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y redis-tools - echo "Testing Redis connection..." - redis-cli -h cache ping - redis-cli -h cache SET test_key "test_value" - redis-cli -h cache GET test_key - echo "Running cache integration tests..."

--- stage: test image: ruby:3.2 services: - name: mysql:8.0 alias: mysql variables: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root_password MYSQL_DATABASE: test_db MYSQL_USER: test_user MYSQL_PASSWORD: test_pass DATABASE_URL: mysql2://test_user:test_pass@mysql:3306/test_db script: - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y default-mysql-client - echo "Waiting for MySQL to be ready..." - sleep 10 - mysql -h mysql -u test_user -ptest_pass test_db -e "SELECT 'MySQL connection successful';" - echo "Running MySQL tests..."

--- stage: test image: node:18 services: - name: mongo:7 alias: mongodb variables: MONGODB_URL: mongodb://mongodb:27017/test_db script: - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y curl gnupg - curl -fsSL https://www.mongodb.org/static/pgp/server-7.0.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-archive-keyring.gpg - echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-archive-keyring.gpg] http://repo.mongodb.org/apt/debian bullseye/mongodb-org/7.0 main" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mongodb-org-7.0.list - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y mongodb-mongosh - echo "Testing MongoDB connection..." - mongosh $MONGODB_URL --eval "db.version()" - echo "Running MongoDB tests..."

--- stage: test image: alpine:3.19 services: - name: nginx:alpine alias: webserver entrypoint: - nginx - "-g" - daemon off; script: - apk add --no-cache curl - sleep 5 - echo "Testing custom service with entrypoint..." - curl -f http://webserver:80 || echo "Service is running"

--- stage: build image: docker:24-cli services: - name: docker:24-dind alias: docker variables: DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2376 DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs" DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: 1 DOCKER_CERT_PATH: "$DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR/client" IMAGE_TAG: "$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA" script: - echo "Building Docker image..." - docker info - | cat > Dockerfile <<EOF FROM alpine:3.19 RUN apk add --no-cache curl CMD ["echo", "Hello from Docker"] EOF - docker build -t test-app:$IMAGE_TAG . - docker images - docker run --rm test-app:$IMAGE_TAG - echo "Docker build completed successfully"
